general.descriptionTextModule: Notifications: the SMS a shopper receives for each order event

list.emptyStateSubline: Add a template to send an SMS alongside the email Shopware already sends for an event.
list.messageLoadError: The SMS templates could not be loaded.
list.messageDeleteSuccess: The SMS template has been deleted.
list.messageDeleteError: The SMS template could not be deleted.

detail.helpTextEvent: The Shopware event this SMS belongs to. It is sent alongside the email for the same event.
detail.helpTextName: Shown in the template list only. Never sent to the shopper.
detail.helpTextSenderId: Overrides the sender configured on the provider, for this template only. Must be approved with the provider.
detail.placeholderSenderId: Leave empty to use the provider setting
detail.helpTextContent: Twig is supported, for example {'{{'} order.orderNumber {'}}'}. Keep it short — every 160 characters is a separate billed message.
detail.placeholderContent: Hi {'{{'} customer.firstName {'}}'}, your order {'{{'} order.orderNumber {'}}'} has shipped.
detail.counterUnicodeHint: This message contains a character outside the GSM alphabet — often a curly quote, an emoji or an accented letter — so it is sent as Unicode and each segment holds only 70 characters instead of 160.
detail.messageLoadError: The SMS template could not be loaded.
detail.messageSaveSuccess: The SMS template has been saved.
detail.messageSaveError: The SMS template could not be saved.
detail.messageEventRequired: Select the event this SMS template belongs to before saving.
detail.messageNameRequired: Enter an internal name before saving.
detail.messageContentRequired: Enter the message text before saving.
detail.tooltipTestSaved: Sends the saved version of this template. Save first if you have unsaved changes.
detail.tooltipTestUnsaved: Save the template before sending a test message.
detail.tooltipTestNoContent: Add message text before sending a test message.
